resources.string:
1. Layout, frame, music aur effect chuno.
2. Next dabao: composer me apni sample photos in boxes me daalo.
3. Post karo. Jo bhi "Use Template" dabayega, usko yehi boxes khali milenge.

Box-wise filter, animation aur duration baad me My Templates > Created > ⋮ > Template edit karo me badal sakte ho.
Template ke saath ye song bajega
Music picker abhi available nahi hai
Song ka start / end composer me music sticker par long-press karke badal sakte ho.
Music sync ke liye pehle song chuno.
Ye sab photo / video boxes par lagta hai. Box-wise alag filter ya animation baad me Template Editor se.
Sample photos chuno. Template isi tarah dikhega, viewers ko boxes khali milenge.

Multi-Scene me template kai scenes ka hota hai. Har scene ka apna layout aur length hota hai, aur scenes ek ke baad ek chalte hain.

Frame, filter, animation aur music sab scenes par ek jaise lagte hain.

Next dabane par composer me har scene ki sample photos daalni hongi.
On karo to template me kai scenes jod sakte ho.
Layout grid se chuna hua scene ka layout badalta hai. Scene par tap karke use chuno.
Aapne badlav kiye hain. Draft My Templates > Drafts me milega.
